verdict.rationale: Tilled documents a dedicated sandbox environment: a sandbox account with its own sandbox Dashboard for managing the integration, test card and bank numbers, amount-based decline simulation, and a mock card-present provider for terminal testing. The separate sandbox account directly delivers testing apart from live production. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that sandbox data and keys are isolated from production, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Your sandbox account will grant you access to the sandbox Dashboard, which will be used to manage your integration.
